subject.title: feat: fire session reset hooks for daily and idle resets

question: Should OpenClaw accept command:daily, command:idle, and lazy before_reset dispatch as the plugin-visible contract for automatic daily/idle rollovers?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible narrow fix for session-memory, but it changes what user-installed command and before_reset hooks can observe on upgrade; that contract choice needs maintainer intent rather than automation guessing between command-action compatibility and a new typed session lifecycle event.

options.title: Accept widened command hooks
options.body: Treat command:daily, command:idle, and lazy before_reset as the supported narrow compatibility path for automatic rollovers after the branch is refreshed and proven.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle reset API
options.body: Hold this branch and move the remaining work to a typed session reset/session end lifecycle event tracked by the broader hook issues.

options.title: Split narrow memory fix
options.body: Land only the bundled session-memory behavior needed for daily/idle persistence while leaving general plugin-visible hook semantics to a later API decision.

recommendation.title: Accept widened command hooks
recommendation.body: Treat command:daily, command:idle, and lazy before_reset as the supported narrow compatibility path for automatic rollovers after the branch is refreshed and proven.
